mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, jti_at, jti_rt, device_type, device_info, ip_address, expires_at, status FROM sys_login_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND device_type = #{deviceType} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_login_record SET status = 'REVOKED', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
